content.value: Consider the following graph. Here each node represents a city and each edge represents (15) [CO3] a road that can be build to connect two cities. Your goal is to minimize road construction costs by removing redundant roads ensuring every city remains reachable from any other city. Develop an algorithm to identify the roads that can be eliminated.
